_note: This file should contain AQA RS source lessons fetched from Supabase (subject_slug='religious-studies-aqa', school_id=NULL). The agent prompt instructs content agents to look up lessons by unit_slug + lesson_number from the content_transfer field in each batch. If this file is empty or missing, agents must fetch directly from Supabase using the query below.
_fetch_query: SELECT l.id, l.lesson_number, l.slug, l.title, l.description, l.content_html, l.practice_questions, l.knowledge_checks, l.flashcard_questions, l.glossary_terms, u.slug as unit_slug FROM lessons l JOIN units u ON l.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.subject_slug = 'religious-studies-aqa' AND u.school_id IS NULL ORDER BY u.sort_order, l.lesson_number
_index_structure: { '<unit_slug>': [ { lesson_number, slug, title, description, content_html, practice_questions, knowledge_checks, flashcard_questions, glossary_terms } ] }
